competitors.name: H-E-B / Joe V's Smart Shop
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported that H-E-B's Joe V's Smart Shop will add two 57,000-square-foot Houston-area stores near City Park and Humble in 2027. The locations will be the first Joe V's stores to carry H-E-B's South Flo pizza, prepared in-house daily and sold as a quick grab-and-go option.

competitors.name: Raybern's
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer highlighted Raybern's new frozen sliders line: Cheeseburger Smashed Sliders, Birria Sliders and Ham & Swiss Sliders. The 9.6-ounce four-packs are launching nationally at Walmart at a suggested $4.68, alongside Raybern's existing Philly Cheesesteak sandwich.

competitors.name: DoorDash / Shopify
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported that DoorDash is now a native sales channel in Shopify's App Store, letting U.S. brick-and-mortar Shopify merchants add product catalogs to DoorDash without separate onboarding or manual catalog uploads. DoorDash said setup time can move from weeks to days and inventory stays synced automatically.

trends.topic: Prepared pizza, frozen handhelds and local delivery are moving toward convenience-led retail execution
trends.magnitude: Three current signals: H-E-B is adding in-house South Flo pizza to Joe V's discount stores; Raybern's is taking frozen sliders national at Walmart at $4.68 per four-pack; DoorDash is reducing onboarding friction for independent Shopify retailers with synced same-day marketplace catalogs.
trends.context: For Real Dough, retail differentiation has to work beyond product quality: buyers are seeing more meal-solution competition from in-store prepared pizza, frozen handheld formats and faster digital distribution paths for local retailers.

breaking.headline: H-E-B Brings South Flo Pizza to Upcoming Joe V's Smart Shops in Houston
breaking.impact: A major Texas retailer is extending a prepared pizza concept into its discount banner, increasing meal-solution competition in value-oriented grocery trips.

breaking.headline: Raybern's Frozen Sliders
breaking.impact: Frozen handheld meals are gaining another national Walmart-backed format at a sub-$5 price point, adding freezer competition around quick meals and shareable snacks.

breaking.headline: DoorDash Adds Shopify Integration to Connect Independent Retailers With On-Demand Delivery
breaking.impact: Independent retailers can more easily make grocery and specialty food catalogs available for same-day delivery, raising digital-shelf and fulfillment expectations for smaller brands and stores.
